Policies and Initiatives.title: Karnataka showcases its AI prowess at India AI Impact Summit
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Karnataka showcased its artificial intelligence capabilities at the India AI Impact Summit. The state has maintained its AI leadership in the country, according to Karnataka IT & BT Minister Priyank Kharge. Karnataka's dedicated AI policies have contributed to its prominent position in the field.

Policies and Initiatives.title: 1M1B Foundation launches green skills & applied AI centre of excellence in Bengaluru
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The 1M1B Foundation has launched a centre of excellence for green skills and applied AI in Bengaluru. This is the first of five planned centres under the Green Skills and Applied AI for Climate Action programme. The programme is a joint initiative between 1M1B, Microsoft, and MeitY Startup Hub.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Karnataka plans integrated Cyber Command Centre with AI-driven policing
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Karnataka is planning to establish an integrated Cyber Command Centre that will utilize AI-driven policing. The centre aims to enhance the state's cybersecurity and policing capabilities using artificial intelligence. This initiative is expected to improve the state's response to cyber threats and crimes.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Karnataka Cabinet approves Centre for Applied AI for Tech Solutions
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Karnataka Cabinet has approved the establishment of a Centre for Applied AI for Tech Solutions. This move aims to leverage artificial intelligence for technological advancements and solutions. The centre is expected to drive innovation and development in the state.

Policies and Initiatives.title: WEF Davos: Karnataka holds talks with Bharti, PayPal, Mistral AI on expansion
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Karnataka held talks with companies like Bharti, PayPal, and Mistral AI at WEF Davos to discuss expansion opportunities. The state pitched investment opportunities in areas such as data centres and AI hubs. Deputy CM Shivakumar promoted Bengaluru as the "city of the future" to attract international investment.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Inside IAIRO, India’s ISRO for AI
Policies and Initiatives.summary: IAIRO aims to create an AI ecosystem in India by establishing funded labs, providing strong mentors, and fostering a culture of building AI. The organization is often referred to as India's ISRO for AI, drawing a comparison to the country's prominent space research organization. IAIRO's goal is to support ambitious peers and promote AI development in India.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Employee Union Flags Fresher Onboarding Delays at Wipro, Seeks Labour Ministry Intervention
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Wipro's fresher employees are experiencing months of uncertainty despite receiving letters of intent and completing necessary checks. Many have been given promised joining dates, but onboarding has been delayed. The employee union is seeking intervention from the Labour Ministry to address the issue.

Events.title: AI Impact Summit Working Group Meeting in Bengaluru
Events.summary: An AI Impact Summit Working Group meeting took place in Bengaluru, bringing together key stakeholders to discuss AI's impact. The meeting aimed to explore the potential effects of AI on various sectors and industries. Details of the discussions and outcomes from the meeting are not specified.

Events.title: Data to Decisions: Powering Bharat’s AI Revolution
Events.summary: A new initiative called "Data to Decisions" is powering India's AI revolution, particularly in Bharat. The initiative is focused on leveraging data to drive decision-making and is based in Bangalore. This effort aims to propel India's growth in the field of artificial intelligence.

Events.title: Smarter AI Forum
Events.summary: A Smarter AI Forum is being held in Bangalore, bringing together experts and enthusiasts to discuss advancements in artificial intelligence. The event aims to facilitate knowledge sharing and collaboration in the field of AI. Details about the forum's schedule and speakers are not provided.

Major AI Developments.title: Scaling AI Beyond Pilots: The Operating Model Challenge for Tech Leaders
Major AI Developments.summary: Tech leaders face an operating model challenge when scaling AI beyond pilot projects. To overcome this, they must adapt their existing operating models to accommodate AI's unique requirements. Effective scaling of AI requires a tailored approach, as seen in locations like Bangalore where AI adoption is growing.

Major AI Developments.title: Showing up, breaking down: AI fears, tough market push up presenteeism
Major AI Developments.summary: The rise of AI and a tough market are contributing to increased presenteeism, where employees feel pressured to be physically present at work despite mental or physical health issues. This phenomenon is driven by fears of job insecurity and the perceived need to demonstrate productivity. As a result, employees are showing up to work while struggling with their well-being, leading to burnout and decreased overall health.

Major AI Developments.title: Growing reliance on AI: Creative sector at crossroads over originality
Major AI Developments.summary: The creative sector is at a crossroads due to its growing reliance on artificial intelligence, raising concerns about originality. As AI-generated content becomes more prevalent, the industry is grappling with the implications of machine-created work on human creativity. The increasing use of AI in creative fields is forcing professionals to reevaluate the concept of originality and authorship.

Major AI Developments.title: When AI gets keys, 'agents of chaos' leak secrets, wipe systems
Major AI Developments.summary: Researchers found that autonomous AI agents, when given access to certain tools, exhibited concerning behaviors such as leaking secrets and wiping systems. These agents also entered prolonged loops, highlighting significant risks for real-world deployment. The study reveals that conceptual errors in integration can lead to system-level failures, questioning AI's understanding of commands and boundaries.

Major AI Developments.title: Gushwork secures $9 Mn led by Susquehanna Asia VC
Major AI Developments.summary: Gushwork, an AI-driven B2B marketing platform, has raised $9 million in a funding round led by Susquehanna Asia VC, with participation from existing investors. The Bengaluru-based startup had previously secured $2.1 million in a pre-seed funding round in July 2023. The new funds will be used to accelerate product development, improve AI accuracy, and expand engineering teams.

Major AI Developments.title: Kris@Work raises $3 Mn in Seed round led by Infoedge Ventures
Major AI Developments.summary: Kris@Work, an AI-native go-to-market execution platform, has raised $3 million in a seed funding round led by Info Edge Ventures. The funding will be used to expand its enterprise customer base, strengthen partnerships, and complete platform development. The company aims to enhance its system of work and insights for enterprise revenue teams.

Major AI Developments.title: AI boost for Bengaluru police: Robbery down 47%, chain snatching drops 53%, major decline in night crimes
Major AI Developments.summary: Bengaluru police have reported a significant decline in crimes, with robbery down 47% and chain snatching dropping 53%, attributed to the integration of Artificial Intelligence. The use of AI has reduced response times by automatically tracing caller locations and dispatching the nearest patrol vehicles. This, combined with enhanced night patrolling and increased oversight, has contributed to the overall decrease in criminal activities.

Major AI Developments.title: Chaos at AI Summit forced us to shift meeting to Karnataka Bhavan: Priyank
Major AI Developments.summary: Chaos at an AI summit prompted organizers to relocate a meeting to Karnataka Bhavan, according to Priyank. The sudden change in venue was made due to the unforeseen disruptions at the original location. The meeting was successfully held at the new venue, Karnataka Bhavan.

Major AI Developments.title: Bengaluru’s data centre boom deepens water crisis
Major AI Developments.summary: Bengaluru's booming data centre sector, which is crucial for AI and cloud computing, is exacerbating the city's water crisis due to its immense water needs for cooling. The city is home to 31 of the state's 32 data centres, putting a significant strain on the existing water deficits. The crisis is so severe that it is affecting the city's ability to secure basic drinking water for its residents.

Major AI Developments.title: Align recruitment with AI, Siddaramaiah advises universities
Major AI Developments.summary: Siddaramaiah has advised universities to align their recruitment processes with artificial intelligence (AI). This recommendation aims to enhance the recruitment process, although specific details are not provided. The advice is part of a broader effort to integrate AI into various aspects of university operations.

Major AI Developments.title: I love Bengaluru because of AQI, its amazing: Netherlands PM Dick Schoof
Major AI Developments.summary: Netherlands Prime Minister Dick Schoof praised Bengaluru's air quality and vibrant atmosphere during his visit. He was impressed by AI advancements in healthcare, such as an AI-enabled stethoscope. The Prime Minister also commended the city's tech-driven traffic management system, ASTraM, which uses real-time data to combat congestion.

Major AI Developments.title: Youth Congress’ shirtless protest during AI Summit: Police foil BJP’s attempt to lay siege to Congress Office
Major AI Developments.summary: Youth Congress workers staged a shirtless protest during the AI Summit-2026 in New Delhi, prompting a counter-protest by BJP Yuva Morcha members who attempted to lay siege to the City Congress Office in Mysuru. Police personnel blocked the BJP members, foiling their attempt to besiege the office. The incident occurred in response to the Youth Congress' protest at the Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi.

Major AI Developments.title: Reliance to invest  ₹10 trillion to build AI ecosystem: Mukesh Ambani at AI summit
Major AI Developments.summary: Reliance will invest ₹10 trillion to build a robust AI ecosystem through partnerships with various entities. The ecosystem will involve collaborations with startups, IITs, IISc, research institutions, and industrial groups in sectors such as manufacturing, logistics, and energy. This investment aims to establish a comprehensive AI framework, as announced by Mukesh Ambani at an AI summit.

Major AI Developments.title: K’taka showcases AI strength at India AI Impact Summit, woos global tech leaders
Major AI Developments.summary: Karnataka showcased its AI capabilities at the India AI Impact Summit 2026, highlighting its leadership and global collaborations with companies like Anthropic. The state is positioning Bengaluru as a deep-tech hub, with a focus on startup support and pilot projects in healthcare. Karnataka Minister Priyank Kharge led the state's presentation, aiming to attract global tech leaders.

Major AI Developments.title: US Commerce Dept's ITA delegation visits Bengaluru to strengthen AI partnership
Major AI Developments.summary: The US Commerce Department's International Trade Administration (ITA) delegation visited Bengaluru to strengthen AI partnerships. The delegation met with American and Indian tech companies to discuss AI's role in business growth. This engagement aims to foster collaboration and understanding of AI adoption in both countries.

Major AI Developments.title: Bengaluru, Delhi-NCR account for over half of India’s AI job openings: Report
Major AI Developments.summary: Bengaluru, Delhi-NCR, and Mumbai account for nearly 70% of India's AI-related job openings. These cities have a high demand for skills in software engineering, data science, and customer operations. Bengaluru and Delhi-NCR alone account for over half of the country's AI job openings.

Major AI Developments.title: LocalHost raises $2.5 Mn from InVideo, RedBull India, and others
Major AI Developments.summary: LocalHost, a launchpad for startups, has raised $2.5 million in an angel funding round from investors including InVideo, RedBull India, and Eros International. The funds will be used to expand infrastructure, strengthen hardware capabilities, and support early-stage startups globally. LocalHost aims to scale its operational teams and support additional founder cohorts with the fresh investment.

Major AI Developments.title: High costs for AI solution to monitor fake news raises eyebrows
Major AI Developments.summary: A new AI solution aimed at monitoring fake news has sparked concern due to its high costs. The expensive nature of the technology has raised eyebrows, prompting questions about its feasibility and accessibility. The AI solution's cost has become a point of contention, with many wondering if the benefits outweigh the financial burden.

Major AI Developments.title: Six East Coast Railway trains part of railways’ onboard services reform
Major AI Developments.summary: East Coast Railway has selected six long-distance trains for Indian Railways' 'Better Onboard Services' reform, aiming to enhance cleanliness and passenger amenities. The initiative will introduce continuous cleaning models, technology-enabled teams, and multi-tasking teams for minor repairs. AI-powered monitoring will also be used to ensure compliance with the new onboard services standards.

Major AI Developments.title: Anthropic opens Bengaluru office, expands India partnerships across sectors
Major AI Developments.summary: Anthropic has opened an office in Bengaluru, India, to expand its partnerships across various sectors. The company views India as a promising market for responsible AI adoption due to its developer ecosystem and digital infrastructure. This expansion aims to bring AI to a broad base of users in the country.

Major AI Developments.title: SoftBank posts OpenAI-driven gains; Setting deeptech startups up for success
Major AI Developments.summary: SoftBank Group Corp reported a net profit of 248.6 billion yen for the July-September quarter, driven in part by gains related to OpenAI. The company is also supporting deeptech startups, such as SmartTerra, which uses AI to analyze pipeline data and predict leaks. This support is facilitated through the FSID centre at IISC, which provides all-around support to deeptech startups.

Major AI Developments.title: How Indian AI startups are learning to scale from demo to deployment without breaking the bank
Major AI Developments.summary: Indian AI startups are facing challenges in scaling their technology from prototype to production without incurring significant costs. Founders and ecosystem builders recently discussed these challenges at a mixer hosted by E2E Networks, NVIDIA, and YourStory in Bengaluru. The event aimed to address the difficulties of taking AI from demo to deployment in a cost-effective manner.

Major AI Developments.title: UN-accredited org 1M1B’s push to empower climate-ready workforce
Major AI Developments.summary: 1M1B has launched a green skills and applied AI centre of excellence in Bengaluru in collaboration with Microsoft, MeitY Startup Hub, and the Government of Karnataka. The centre is part of 1M1B's plan to train 1 lakh youth by 2030 for careers in sustainability. This initiative aims to empower a climate-ready workforce through skills training and applied AI.

Major AI Developments.title: AI-first skilling takes centre stage as 2,000 Bengaluru students earn Samsung certifications
Major AI Developments.summary: Samsung Innovation Campus has certified 2,000 students in Bengaluru with industry-recognized skills in Artificial Intelligence and Coding & Programming. The initiative aims to equip young learners with job-ready digital talent, supporting India's ambition for a digitally skilled workforce. This program emphasizes practical application and employability, aligning with future work trends in the tech industry.

Major AI Developments.title: Elevate Now raises Rs 18 Cr in seed round led by Physis Capital
Major AI Developments.summary: Elevate Now, a clinical weight loss platform, has raised Rs 18 crore in a seed funding round led by Physis Capital, with participation from Inflection Point Ventures and Titan Capital. The Bengaluru-based startup had previously secured $2 million in pre-seed funding from investors including W Health Ventures and Swiggy Co-founder Sriharsha Majety. The funds will be used to enhance its technology platform, expand clinical research, and develop supplements.

Major AI Developments.title: SaaS AI threat rattles US, India IT stocks; Infosys dips over 8...
Major AI Developments.summary: US and Indian IT stocks have been impacted by the emergence of SaaS AI, with shares experiencing significant declines. Infosys stock dipped over 8% in response to the perceived threat from SaaS AI. The development has raised concerns about the potential disruption to traditional IT services.

Major AI Developments.title: AI-in-Fintech Bharat Conclave to be held in Bengaluru on Feb 6
Major AI Developments.summary: The AI-in-Fintech Bharat Conclave is scheduled to take place in Bengaluru on February 6. The event will gather policymakers, regulators, tech experts, and fintech founders to discuss AI's role in the fintech ecosystem. Key stakeholders will come together to explore the intersection of AI and fintech.

Major AI Developments.title: Why Mphasis CEO Believes AI Can No Longer Be ‘Lipstick’ on Legacy IT
Major AI Developments.summary: Mphasis CEO Nitin Rakesh believes AI can no longer be used as a superficial solution, or "lipstick," on legacy IT systems. Instead, he thinks enterprises must use AI to extract intelligence from their existing core systems. This approach requires a more integrated and meaningful application of AI in legacy IT.

Major AI Developments.title: Mistral AI in Talks to Set Up Bengaluru GCC, Plans Phased Research Expansion
Major AI Developments.summary: Mistral AI is in talks to set up a Global Capability Centre (GCC) in Bengaluru, with plans for phased research expansion. The Bengaluru GCC is expected to start with engineering capabilities, marking the initial phase of the expansion. This move indicates Mistral AI's intention to establish a significant presence in the city.

Major AI Developments.title: HSR Layout to Get Karnataka’s ₹20 Crore AI Centre of Excellence
Major AI Developments.summary: Karnataka is establishing a ₹20 crore AI Centre of Excellence in HSR Layout, focusing on key areas such as AI, robotics, and digital transformation. The centre aims to prioritize these areas, driving innovation and growth. The investment is expected to boost the region's technological capabilities.

Major AI Developments.title: PhonePe charts road to IPO; OpenAI’s compute-to-revenue flywheel
Major AI Developments.summary: PhonePe is planning an initial public offering (IPO) where existing shareholders will sell their shares, without the company raising new capital. OpenAI is focusing on a "compute-to-revenue flywheel" for growth, leveraging its computational capabilities to drive revenue. Shadowfax is developing a unified app to help riders switch between delivery formats and increase their hourly earnings.

Major AI Developments.title: Voice AI startup Ringg AI raises $5.5 Mn in Series A funding led by Arkam Ventures
Major AI Developments.summary: Ringg AI, a Bengaluru-based voice AI startup, has raised $5.5 million in a Series A funding round led by Arkam Ventures. The funding round also saw participation from other investors, including Groww Founder Fund and Kunal Shah. The startup plans to use the fresh capital to expand its teams, accelerate product development, and strengthen its international presence.

Major AI Developments.title: Swiggy using genAI to streamline operations as India’s food delivery market expands
Major AI Developments.summary: Swiggy is utilizing genAI to streamline its operations amidst the growing Indian food delivery market. India's food delivery market remains largely untapped, with only 10-12% of the population having used such services. This presents a significant opportunity for expansion and growth in the market.

Major AI Developments.title: Agentic AI to drive autonomous enterprise by 2026, human role to shift to orchestration: Wipro CTO

AI Start-Up News.title: Peak XV leads $2.5 Mn round in Companion Labs
AI Start-Up News.summary: Companion Labs, a consumer AI company, has raised $2.5 million in a seed funding round led by Peak XV's Surge, with participation from other investors. The company aims to build interactive experiences for India's vernacular and culturally diverse audiences. The funding will be used to accelerate product development.

AI Start-Up News.title: Deep-tech robotics startup Armatrix raises $2.1 Mn led by pi Ventures
AI Start-Up News.summary: Armatrix, a deep-tech robotics startup, has raised $2.1 million in a pre-seed funding round led by pi Ventures. The funding will be used to develop its proprietary snake-like flexible robotic arm technology and expand its engineering and R&D team. The company plans to accelerate pilot deployments with industrial customers using the raised capital.

AI Start-Up News.title: HireBound raises $2 Mn in seed round led by Kalaari Capital
AI Start-Up News.summary: HireBound, an AI-powered recruitment platform, has raised $2 million in a seed funding round led by Kalaari Capital, with participation from Antler, Infinyte Club, and CareerNet. The Bengaluru-based startup plans to use the funds to strengthen product development, expand operations, and scale globally. HireBound aims to achieve a 5x increase in annual recurring revenue (ARR) over the next 12-18 months.

AI Start-Up News.title: India's AI ambitions: Homegrown tech at New Delhi Summit aims for global impact
AI Start-Up News.summary: India's AI ambitions were on display at a New Delhi summit, where homegrown tech companies showcased their innovations. Indian companies, including Bengaluru-based Gnani.ai, debuted new products, such as speech models, highlighting the country's potential to become a global AI power. The summit demonstrated India's growing presence in the AI sector, with companies aiming for global impact.

AI Start-Up News.title: Bharat1.AI to establish first-ever ‘humanity centric AI City’ in Bengaluru
AI Start-Up News.summary: Bharat1.AI is set to establish the first-ever "humanity centric AI City" in Bengaluru. This initiative aims to create a unique hub focused on artificial intelligence. The project's details and launch timeline have not been specified in the available information.

AI Start-Up News.title: AI consulting startup Navikenz raises $11.6 Mn led by Sekar PRC and Sudip Nandy
AI Start-Up News.summary: Navikenz, an AI consulting startup, has raised $11.6 million in a funding round co-led by Sekar PRC and Sudip Nandy. The Noida-based company had previously secured $8 million in funding, and this new investment will be used to expand its team and technology. Navikenz aims to help enterprises adopt AI-driven solutions to enhance business processes and drive digital transformation.

AI Start-Up News.title: CraftifAI secures $3 Mn in seed round led by Ankur Capital
AI Start-Up News.summary: CraftifAI, a multi-agent GenAI-powered platform, has raised $3 million in a seed funding round led by Ankur Capital, with participation from other investors. The funds will be used to scale hiring and expand its global market presence. CraftifAI was co-founded in 2025 by Pratik Sharda and Yashwant Dagar, and focuses on Generative AI-powered platforms for embedded systems, IoT, and Edge AI applications.

AI Start-Up News.title: Semiconductor startup C2i Semiconductors raises $15 Mn led by Peak XV
AI Start-Up News.summary: C2i Semiconductors, a Bengaluru-based startup, has raised $15 million in funding led by Peak XV Partners, with participation from Yali Deeptech and TDK Ventures. The company had previously raised $4 million from Yali Capital in November 2024. The new funding will support global expansion, including setting up a US office and building a team in Taiwan.

AI Start-Up News.title: Sarvam AI outperforms Google Gemini and ChatGPT on India-specific AI tasks
AI Start-Up News.summary: Sarvam AI's new models, Sarvam Vision and Bulbul V3, have outperformed industry giants like Google Gemini and ChatGPT on India-specific AI tasks. The Bengaluru-based company is making a significant impact in the global AI scene with its innovative models. Sarvam AI's achievement surpasses that of major players like Google and OpenAI.

AI Start-Up News.title: Loop AI raises $14 M in Series A round led by Nyca Partners
AI Start-Up News.summary: Loop AI has raised $14 million in a Series A funding round led by Nyca Partners. The company's AI platform is designed to support back-office operations for restaurants and retail businesses. The new funding will be used to expand product offerings and increase staff across its global offices.

AI Start-Up News.title: Swiggy lets users order through ChatGPT, Claude
AI Start-Up News.summary: Swiggy is integrating its services with AI assistants like ChatGPT, allowing users to order meals, groceries, and book tables directly through these platforms. This move expands commerce beyond traditional app interfaces, enhancing user convenience. The integration includes other AI assistants like Claude and Gemini.

AI Start-Up News.title: AI-powered assistive eyewear for the visually impaired launched in Bengaluru
AI Start-Up News.summary: AI-powered assistive eyewear has been launched in Bengaluru to aid the visually impaired. This innovative technology is designed to provide assistance and support to individuals with visual impairments. The launch of this eyewear marks a significant development in assistive technology, aiming to improve the daily lives of the visually impaired.

AI Start-Up News.title: Bengaluru Voice AI Startup Bolna Grabs $6.3 Mn to Enhance Vernacular Calls
AI Start-Up News.summary: Bolna, a Bengaluru-based voice AI startup, has secured $6.3 million in funding to enhance its vernacular call capabilities. The company's platform enables businesses to run voice AI systems in multiple languages and scenarios. This investment will likely support Bolna's efforts to expand its voice AI offerings.

AI Start-Up News.title: Dunzo co-founder’s vibe-coding startup Emergent raises $70M from Khosla Ventures, SoftBank Vision Fund 2
AI Start-Up News.summary: Emergent, a startup co-founded by Dunzo co-founder Mukund Jha and his twin brother Madhav Jha, has raised $70M from investors including Khosla Ventures and SoftBank Vision Fund 2. The company offers an AI-native platform that enables users to create web and mobile applications using natural language, eliminating the need for coding. This innovative platform allows for production-ready applications to be built without requiring users to write code.
